name: brightloop-subscriptions
description: Brightloop Software - subscription management system (products, plans, recurring billing, payments, reporting)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
